output.reason: The computed artifact diff between [ev-782bc47d120d] (v2.6.4 install.yaml) and [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] (v2.7.0 install.yaml) changes the CRD's storage version from v1beta2 to v1. Existing objects stay stored as v1beta2 until they are rewritten. Whether an environment is exposed depends on what is stored in the cluster, which the CRD's status.storedVersions records. It does not depend on which apiVersion the manifests use. Under the old storage version every existing object was stored as v1beta2, even when written through v1. So gvk-in-use v1beta2 misses environments whose manifests use v1, and it flags environments that have already migrated. The canonical stored-version migration shape for the CRD applies here.

correction.statement: The storage version of imageupdateautomations.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io changes from v1beta2 to v1. Exposed environments are those where the CRD's status.storedVersions still lists v1beta2. Their stored ImageUpdateAutomation objects must be rewritten and storedVersions updated before a later release removes v1beta2.
